recommendation: Keep the empty external-repo audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. Any future changes to alternate-codes should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than by reintroducing a core StructureDefinition source.
issue_request: FHIR-33270 was a Published FHIR-core/MnM change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking for a general extension on code and similar coded datatypes to preserve the original coded concept when mapping into a required FHIR code. The accepted resolution was to add a standard extension named alternate-codes with value type CodeableConcept and context of use code.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed application commit exists in the core checkout. The implementation is in the FHIR Extension Pack: commit 3f8b7247a2a8fe9f01c7b093088dad801e3f53ce added input/definitions/datatypes/StructureDefinition-alternate-codes.xml, and commit 80fce22d021e9a5367059f3c350efe74494d05e0 corrected Extension.url to http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/alternate-codes.
additional_context: The current core source has no active StructureDefinition source for alternate-codes; it only retains the assigned OID in source/oids.ini. The current Extension Pack source defines http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/alternate-codes with CodeableConcept value and code context, and later FHIR-43060 expanded the same extension to string and Coding contexts in extension-pack commit b1b405821c9d0d74fa9f9fbaad9427d7875bcbfb. Jira comments on FHIR-33270 also point reviewers to the Extension Pack page, confirming that the apparent missing core source is an ownership/build-scope move rather than an unapplied core change.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The seed request has been applied in the FHIR Extension Pack, which is outside this core checkout for this run, and the current core source is not missing an in-scope authoritative definition.
